description: What starts a task (besides a run by hand): a schedule, or a git push to a branch of a repo on the host, seen by polling its head. Its events' payloads fill the task's form (fills).

at.description: A schedule's: the host's local time it runs at, HH:MM.

days.description: A schedule's at's days, 0 Monday to 6 Sunday.

next.description: A schedule's: when it fires next.

repo.description: A git push's: the repo's folder on the host.

branch.description: A git push's: the branch watched.

poll_s.description: A git push's: seconds between looks at the branch.

seen.description: A git push's: the branch's head as last seen.

fills.description: A form field's name: the payload's key that fills it (a field not named takes the payload's key of its own name).

error.description: Why it couldn't look or fire, last time.
